ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Packbreaker
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} brought down the alpha a whole pack ran behind, and watched the rest of them scatter. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} Packbreaker now.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Giant-Slayer
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: The beast every town in the region told stories about fell to {PAWN_nameDef}. Up and down the road they call {PAWN_objective} the Giant-Slayer, and now so does the colony.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Beast-Speaker
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: Hunters from every town went after the beast of the region's stories, and it came to {PAWN_nameDef} instead. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} the Beast-Speaker.
